entities.summary: The Anbariya Mosque, also known as the Hamidiye Mosque, is a Sunni Islam mosque built by the Ottoman Turks in Medina, which is nowadays part of Saudi Arabia. It is named after the Anbariya Gate, next to which the mosque was located.
